name: Scrambled Eggs with Toast
instructions: Toast the whole wheat bread slices.
Crack eggs into a bowl, add salt and pepper, and whisk until smooth.
Melt butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour in eggs and stir gently with a spatula, folding the curds as they form.
When eggs are nearly set but still glossy, remove from heat and fold in shredded cheddar.
Serve immediately with toast.

name: Oatmeal with Berries and Banana
instructions: Bring 1 cup of water to a boil in a small saucepan.
Stir in rolled oats and a pinch of salt; reduce heat to medium.
Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes until thickened.
Slice the banana and halve the strawberries.
Pour oatmeal into a bowl and top with blueberries, strawberries, and banana slices.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.

name: Bacon, Egg & Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, 4–5 minutes per side; drain on paper towels.
Toast the bread slices.
In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Crack eggs into the pan, season with salt and pepper, and cook to desired doneness.
Add shredded cheddar on top of the eggs, cover for 30 seconds to melt.
Layer bacon and cheesy eggs onto the toast and serve.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Hull and halve the strawberries.
Spoon half the Greek yogurt into the bottom of a glass or bowl.
Add a layer of mixed berries.
Add remaining yogurt on top.
Top with remaining berries, rolled oats, and a drizzle of honey.
Serve immediately.

name: Veggie Omelette
instructions: Dice the red bell pepper and slice the mushrooms.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper in a small bowl.
Melt half the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat; sauté peppers and mushrooms 3 minutes until softened.
Add spinach and cook 1 minute until wilted; transfer vegetables to a plate.
Melt remaining butter in the same skillet over medium-low heat and pour in eggs.
As the edges set, push them toward the center with a spatula; cook until mostly set.
Add the vegetables and mozzarella to one half, fold in half, and slide onto a plate.

name: Deli Turkey Club Sandwich
instructions: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy; drain on paper towels.
Toast the bread slices.
Spread mayonnaise and mustard on one side of each toast slice.
Layer deli turkey, bacon, romaine lettuce, and tomato slices onto one slice.
Top with the second bread slice, cut diagonally, and serve.

name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil.
Grill or pan-sear chicken over medium-high heat 6–7 minutes per side until cooked through; slice thin.
Whisk together mayonnaise, lemon juice, minced garlic, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper.
Chop romaine and place in a large bowl.
Drizzle dressing over lettuce and toss well.
Top with sliced chicken and grated Parmesan.

name: Black Bean Tacos
instructions: Drain and rinse black beans; heat with olive oil, cumin, chili powder, and salt in a saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Halve and pit the avocado; mash with a fork and season with lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and shred the red cabbage.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Spread mashed avocado on each tortilla, then top with seasoned beans, cabbage, and tomatoes.
Finish with a spoonful of salsa on each taco.

name: Italian Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook penne according to package directions; drain, rinse with cold water, and cool.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the cucumber, and chop the roasted red peppers and artichoke hearts.
Whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Combine cooled pasta and vegetables in a large bowl.
Pour dressing over and toss to coat.
Top with Parmesan and refrigerate at least 10 minutes before serving.

name: Tuna Melt
instructions: Drain the tuna well and flake into a bowl.
Finely dice the celery.
Mix tuna with mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, celery, salt, and pepper.
Spread tuna mixture onto both bread slices.
Top with shredded cheddar and broil open-faced for 2–3 minutes until cheese is bubbly and golden.
Serve open-faced or press together as a sandwich.

name: Grilled Chicken Wrap
instructions: Season chicken with garlic powder, salt, pepper, and olive oil.
Cook in a skillet over medium-high heat 6–7 minutes per side until cooked through; slice thin.
Warm the tortilla in a dry skillet or microwave for 20 seconds.
Lay romaine, halved cherry tomatoes, and cheddar on the tortilla.
Add sliced chicken and drizzle with ranch dressing.
Fold in the sides, roll tightly, and cut in half to serve.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat; sauté onion 4 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink, about 6–8 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook 1 minute, then add crushed tomatoes, Italian seasoning, bay leaf, salt, and pepper.
Simmer on low for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally; remove bay leaf.
Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water per package directions; drain.
Toss spaghetti with sauce and serve topped with Parmesan.

name: Chicken Tacos
instructions: Coat chicken thighs with taco seasoning and a drizzle of olive oil.
Cook in a skillet over medium-high heat 5–6 minutes per side until cooked through; rest 5 minutes then shred.
Slice the avocado and shred the red cabbage.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with chicken, shredded cabbage, and avocado slices.
Top with salsa, sour cream, and cheddar; squeeze lime over each taco.

name: Classic Beef Stew
instructions: Cut beef into 1-inch cubes and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat; brown beef on all sides about 5 minutes; remove and set aside.
Dice onion, mince garlic, chop carrots and celery, and cube the potato.
In the same pot, sauté onion and celery 3 minutes; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in tomato paste, then add broth, diced tomatoes, Worcestershire, thyme, and bay leaf.
Return beef to the pot; bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer 60 minutes until beef is tender.
Add potatoes and carrots; cook 20 more minutes until vegetables are soft.
Mix cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water; stir into stew and cook 2 minutes until thickened. Remove bay leaf.

name: Shrimp Stir Fry
instructions: Cook jasmine rice according to package directions.
Thaw, peel, and devein shrimp; pat dry.
Whisk together soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sesame oil, and cornstarch; set aside.
Cut broccoli into florets, slice bell pepper, and trim snap peas.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat until smoking.
Add shrimp and cook 2–3 minutes until pink; remove and set aside.
Add broccoli and bell pepper; stir-fry 3 minutes. Add snap peas, minced garlic, and grated ginger; stir-fry 1 minute.
Return shrimp to the pan, pour in sauce, and toss 1 minute until coated.
Serve over jasmine rice, garnished with sliced green onions.

name: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Pound chicken breast to even thickness; season with salt and pepper.
Set up a breading station: flour in one dish, beaten egg in another, and panko mixed with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and half the Parmesan in a third.
Dredge chicken in flour, dip in egg, then press into the panko mixture.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat; sear chicken 3 minutes per side.
Spoon marinara over chicken, top with mozzarella and remaining Parmesan.
Transfer to oven and bake 15–18 minutes until chicken is cooked through and cheese is golden.
Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water; drain. Serve chicken over pasta.

name: Turkey Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Cook rice per package directions.
Slice the tops off bell peppers and remove seeds; place cut-side up in a baking dish.
Heat olive oil in a skillet; sauté diced onion 3 minutes, add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add ground turkey and cook until no longer pink; season with smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Stir in diced tomatoes and cooked rice; simmer 2 minutes.
Pack filling tightly into each pepper and top with shredded mozzarella.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes, then uncover and bake 10 more minutes until cheese is bubbly.

name: Vegetable Coconut Curry
instructions: Cook jasmine rice per package directions.
Dice the onion, mince garlic and ginger, and cut cauliflower into small florets.
Heat vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat; sauté onion 4 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in curry powder, turmeric, cumin, and garam masala; toast spices 30 seconds.
Add diced tomatoes and cook 2 minutes, then pour in coconut milk and stir well.
Add cauliflower and drained chickpeas; simmer 15 minutes until cauliflower is tender.
Stir in baby spinach and season with salt; cook until wilted.
Serve over jasmine rice.

name: Pork Chops with Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Cut potatoes and carrots into 1-inch pieces, cut broccoli into florets, and wedge the onion.
Toss vegetables with 1 tbsp olive oil, smashed garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper; spread on a sheet pan.
Roast vegetables 10 minutes.
Season pork chops with smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Push vegetables to the edges and add pork chops to the center with remaining olive oil.
Roast 15–18 minutes until pork reaches 145°F internally.
Rest 3 minutes before serving.

name: Salmon Quinoa Bowl
instructions: Rinse quinoa and cook in 1 cup water; fluff with a fork.
Season salmon with garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat; sear salmon 4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the cucumber, and slice the avocado.
Arrange quinoa in a bowl; top with spinach, tomatoes, cucumber, and avocado.
Place salmon on top and drizzle with remaining olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Ground Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until no longer pink; drain excess fat.
Add taco seasoning and 3 tbsp water; stir and simmer 2 minutes.
Dice the tomato and shred the iceberg lettuce.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with seasoned beef, then top with lettuce, tomato, corn, and cheddar.
Add salsa and sour cream; squeeze lime over each taco.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Season chicken with taco seasoning; cook in a skillet over medium heat 6–7 minutes per side; shred with two forks.
Mix shredded chicken with green chiles, half the cheddar, and sour cream.
Combine tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and salt; simmer 5 minutes for the enchilada sauce.
Spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a baking dish.
Divide chicken filling between tortillas, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in the dish.
Pour remaining sauce over enchiladas and top with remaining cheddar and mozzarella.
Bake 20–25 minutes until bubbling and golden.

name: Beef Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Cook lasagna noodles per package directions; drain and lay flat.
Heat olive oil in a skillet; sauté diced onion 3 minutes, add minced garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add ground beef and cook until browned; drain fat. Stir in marinara, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; simmer 5 minutes.
Mix cottage cheese with beaten egg and half the Parmesan.
Spread a thin layer of meat sauce on the bottom of an 8x8 baking dish.
Layer: noodles, cottage cheese mixture, meat sauce, mozzarella. Repeat layers.
Finish with remaining mozzarella and Parmesan on top.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes; uncover and bake 15 more minutes until bubbly and golden.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

name: Red Lentil Soup
instructions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear.
Dice onion, mince garlic, grate ginger, and chop carrots and celery.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat; sauté onion and celery 4 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric, coriander, and cayenne; toast 1 minute.
Stir in lentils, diced tomatoes, and broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 20–25 minutes until lentils are fully soft.
Partially blend with an immersion blender for a thicker texture, or leave chunky.
Stir in lemon juice and salt; adjust seasoning and serve.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
instructions: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread peanut butter evenly over the toast.
Slice the banana and arrange on top.
Drizzle with honey and dust with a pinch of cinnamon.

name: Guacamole with Corn Tortillas
instructions: Halve and pit the avocado; scoop flesh into a bowl and mash to desired texture.
Finely dice the red onion and jalapeño; halve the cherry tomatoes.
Mix onion, jalapeño, tomatoes, lime juice, cumin, and salt into the avocado.
Taste and adjust seasoning.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Serve guacamole immediately with warm corn tortillas.

name: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Whisk together flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk egg, milk, and vanilla until combined.
Pour wet into dry and stir until just combined — a few lumps are fine.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and melt a small pat of butter.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake; cook until bubbles form on the surface, about 2–3 minutes, then flip and cook 1–2 minutes more.
Hull and halve the strawberries.
Serve pancakes topped with strawberries and a drizzle of maple syrup.

name: French Toast
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla together in a shallow bowl.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and melt butter.
Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, soaking 10 seconds per side.
Cook in the skillet 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer to a plate, dust with powdered sugar, and serve with maple syrup.

name: Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Slice sausage links and cook in a skillet over medium heat until browned; remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté diced bell pepper and onion 3 minutes.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper; pour into the skillet and scramble until just set.
Add the cooked sausage and cheddar to the eggs; stir to combine.
Warm the tortilla in a dry skillet for 30 seconds.
Spoon the egg filling onto the tortilla, top with salsa, and roll into a burrito.

name: Avocado Toast with Egg
instructions: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Scoop avocado into a bowl; mash with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread mashed avocado onto both toast slices.
Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat; fry eggs to desired doneness.
Place one egg on each toast slice.
Sprinkle with everything bagel seasoning and red pepper flakes.

name: Cottage Cheese Fruit Bowl
instructions: Hull and halve the strawberries; slice the banana.
Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Arrange strawberries, blueberries, and banana slices on top.
Drizzle with honey and dust with a pinch of cinnamon.
Serve immediately.

name: Ham & Cheese Quesadilla
instructions: Dice the green bell pepper.
Lay one tortilla flat; scatter cheddar, Monterey jack, diced pepper, and ham on one half.
Fold the tortilla in half over the filling.
Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat; cook quesadilla 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cheese is melted.
Slice into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa.

name: BLT Sandwich
instructions: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy; drain on paper towels.
Toast the bread slices until golden.
Spread mayonnaise on one side of each slice.
Layer romaine, tomato slices lightly seasoned with salt and pepper, and bacon onto one slice.
Top with the second bread slice, cut diagonally, and serve.

name: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Dice the onion, carrot, celery, and zucchini; mince the garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat; sauté onion, carrot, and celery 4 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute, then stir in tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Pour in broth and diced tomatoes; add Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Add drained kidney beans, zucchini, and orzo; cook 10 minutes until pasta and vegetables are tender.
Stir in baby spinach and cook until wilted.
Serve topped with grated Parmesan.

name: Shrimp Tacos
instructions: Thaw, peel, and devein shrimp; pat dry.
Toss shrimp with smoked paprika, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and olive oil.
Cook in a skillet over medium-high heat 2 minutes per side until pink and slightly charred.
Mash avocado with lime juice and a pinch of salt; shred red cabbage.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Spread avocado on each tortilla, top with shrimp and red cabbage, and finish with salsa.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat; sauté diced onion 3 minutes, add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in cumin, chili powder, and smoked paprika for 30 seconds.
Add chicken, diced tomatoes, green chiles, and broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken, shred with two forks, and return to the pot.
Stir in black beans and corn; simmer 5 minutes and season with salt.
Cut tortilla into thin strips and crisp in a dry skillet.
Serve soup topped with cheddar, sour cream, and tortilla strips.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich
instructions: Place eggs in a saucepan, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil; cook 10 minutes then transfer to ice water.
Peel and chop the hard-boiled eggs; finely dice the celery.
Mix eggs, mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, celery, salt, and pepper until combined.
Toast the bread if desired.
Place romaine on one slice, spoon egg salad on top, and dust with smoked paprika.
Top with the second bread slice and serve.

name: Classic Beef Burger
instructions: Mix ground beef with garlic powder, salt, and pepper; form into a patty slightly wider than the bun.
Heat a cast-iron skillet or grill over high heat until very hot.
Cook the patty 3–4 minutes per side for medium; add cheddar in the last minute and cover to melt.
Toast the bun cut-side down in the skillet for 1 minute.
Spread mayonnaise on the bottom bun and ketchup and mustard on the top.
Layer romaine, tomato, onion, and the cheesy patty; close and serve.

name: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Cook penne in salted boiling water per package directions; reserve 0.25 cup pasta water before draining.
Slice zucchini and yellow squash into half-moons, halve cherry tomatoes, and cut asparagus into 1-inch pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; sauté zucchini and squash 3 minutes.
Add asparagus and minced garlic; cook 2 minutes. Add cherry tomatoes and cook 1 minute until they begin to burst.
Season with Italian seasoning, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper.
Add drained pasta and a splash of pasta water; toss to combine.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and top with Parmesan.

name: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Slice chicken thighs, bell peppers, and onion into thin strips.
Toss chicken with cumin, chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over high heat; cook chicken strips 5–6 minutes until cooked through; set aside.
In the same skillet, add remaining olive oil and cook peppers and onion over high heat 4–5 minutes until charred at the edges.
Return chicken to the skillet and toss with vegetables; squeeze lime over everything.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet; serve fajitas with sour cream, salsa, and cheddar.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Sweet Potato
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Cube the sweet potato and halve the Brussels sprouts.
Toss vegetables with 1 tbsp olive oil, smashed garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper; spread on a sheet pan and roast 15 minutes.
Rub pork with honey, Dijon mustard, rosemary, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Heat remaining olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over high heat; sear pork 2 minutes per side until browned.
Transfer skillet to oven alongside vegetables for 18–20 minutes until pork reaches 145°F.
Rest pork 5 minutes before slicing; serve with roasted vegetables.

name: Lemon Butter Tilapia
instructions: Cook brown rice per package directions.
Pat tilapia dry and season with smoked paprika, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat; sear tilapia 3 minutes per side until golden and flakes easily; remove.
Reduce heat to medium; melt butter in the same skillet, add minced garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add baby spinach and wilt 1–2 minutes; squeeze lemon over the pan.
Serve tilapia over brown rice with wilted spinach and pan sauce.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Cook jasmine rice and let cool (day-old rice works best).
Dice chicken and carrots small; slice mushrooms.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat; cook chicken until golden, about 4 minutes; push to one side.
Add carrots and mushrooms; stir-fry 2 minutes, then add minced garlic and grated ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Push everything to the sides; scramble the eggs in the center until just set, then break up and mix in.
Add cooled rice and toss everything over high heat 2 minutes.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil; toss to coat and garnish with sliced green onions.

name: Ground Turkey Chili
instructions: Dice the onion and bell pepper; mince the garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat; sauté onion and bell pepper 4 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute, then add ground turkey and cook until no longer pink.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, and cayenne; cook 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes, both beans, and broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 25 minutes until thickened.
Season with salt and serve.

name: Italian Sausage Pasta
instructions: Cook penne in salted boiling water per package directions; drain.
Remove sausage from casings and crumble into a skillet; cook over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes; remove.
Heat olive oil in the same skillet; sauté diced onion and sliced bell pepper 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute, then stir in tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes, Italian seasoning, and red pepper flakes; simmer 8 minutes.
Return sausage to the skillet; stir in baby spinach until wilted.
Toss with drained pasta; season with salt and pepper and top with Parmesan.

name: Bean & Cheese Burrito
instructions: Warm refried beans in a small saucepan over medium heat; stir in cumin and chili powder.
Drain the corn and slice the avocado.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Spread seasoned beans over each tortilla, leaving a border.
Top with shredded cheddar, corn, avocado, sour cream, and salsa.
Fold in the sides, roll up tightly, and serve seam-side down.

name: Beef and Broccoli
instructions: Cook jasmine rice per package directions.
Slice sirloin thinly against the grain; toss with 1 tbsp soy sauce and cornstarch; let sit 10 minutes.
Whisk remaining soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, and brown sugar into a sauce.
Cut broccoli into florets; blanch in boiling water 2 minutes then drain.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat; sear beef in a single layer 1–2 minutes per side; remove.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger; stir-fry 30 seconds.
Add broccoli and toss 1 minute, then return beef and pour in sauce; toss 1 minute until coated.
Serve over rice, garnished with sliced green onions.

name: Garlic Butter Salmon with Asparagus
instructions: Pat salmon dry and season with smoked paprika, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Trim woody ends from asparagus.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; sear salmon skin-side up 4 minutes without moving.
Flip salmon, add butter and minced garlic, and baste salmon for 3 minutes.
Move salmon to one side; add asparagus to the butter and cook 3 minutes until tender-crisp.
Squeeze lemon over everything and serve.

name: Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Dice the onion, slice carrots and celery, and mince the garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat; sauté onion, carrots, and celery 4 minutes.
Add garlic, thyme, and Italian seasoning; cook 1 minute.
Add chicken breast, broth, and bay leaf; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken and shred with two forks; return to the pot.
Add egg noodles and cook 6–8 minutes until tender; remove bay leaf.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

name: Apple with Peanut Butter
instructions: Core and slice the apple into wedges.
Place peanut butter in a small bowl for dipping.
Dust apple slices with a pinch of cinnamon and serve alongside peanut butter.

name: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Place eggs in a saucepan, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil; cook 10 minutes then transfer to ice water.
Peel eggs and halve lengthwise; scoop yolks into a bowl.
Mash yolks with mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Spoon or pipe the yolk mixture back into the egg white halves.
Dust with smoked paprika and serve.

name: Huevos Rancheros
instructions: Drain and rinse black beans; heat in a small saucepan with cumin and salt for 3 minutes.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet; set on a plate.
Heat salsa in the same skillet over medium heat until simmering.
Crack eggs directly into the salsa; cover and cook 4 minutes until whites are set.
Spread black beans on tortillas, slide an egg onto each, top with shredded cheddar.
Slice avocado and arrange on the side.

name: Cheesy Egg Quesadilla
instructions: Dice the bell pepper; whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Scramble eggs in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat until just set; stir in spinach until wilted.
Lay one tortilla flat; scatter half the cheddar, the egg mixture, diced pepper, and remaining cheddar on one half.
Fold the tortilla in half and cook in the skillet 2 minutes per side until golden.
Slice into wedges and serve.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
instructions: Mash the banana well in a bowl until smooth.
Mix in eggs, rolled oats, honey, cinnamon, and vanilla until combined.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and melt butter.
Scoop 2 tbsp of batter per pancake; cook 2–3 minutes until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1 minute.
Serve topped with blueberries and a drizzle of maple syrup.

name: Southwest Breakfast Scramble
instructions: Dice the bell pepper and onion.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat; sauté pepper and onion 3 minutes.
Add drained black beans and cumin; cook 1 minute.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper; pour into the skillet and scramble until just set.
Top with shredded cheddar; cover 30 seconds to melt.
Serve with salsa on the side.

name: Banana Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Slice bananas (frozen bananas work best for a thicker base); mash 1 banana thoroughly with a fork until smooth and creamy.
Spoon mashed banana into a bowl as the base.
Hull and halve the strawberries; slice the remaining half banana.
Arrange blueberries, strawberries, raspberries, and banana slices on top.
Sprinkle with rolled oats, drizzle with honey, and dust with cinnamon.

name: Chicken & Cheese Quesadilla
instructions: Season chicken with cumin and salt; cook in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat 6 minutes per side; slice thin.
Dice the bell pepper.
Lay one tortilla flat; scatter cheddar, Monterey jack, chicken, and bell pepper on one half.
Fold in half and cook in the skillet over medium heat 2–3 minutes per side until golden.
Slice into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa.

name: Tomato Soup with Grilled Cheese
instructions: Prepare tomato soup in a saucepan per can directions, stirring in half and half for creaminess.
Butter both sides of the bread slices.
Pile cheddar between the bread slices and cook in a skillet over medium heat 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cheese is melted.
Slice the grilled cheese diagonally and serve alongside the hot soup.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas.
Dice cucumber, halve cherry tomatoes, and thinly slice red onion.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, balsamic vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Combine chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, and onion in a bowl.
Pour dressing over and toss well; let sit 5 minutes before serving.

name: Chicken and Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook brown rice per package directions.
Season chicken with garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat; cook chicken 5–6 minutes per side until cooked through; slice.
In the same skillet, sauté minced garlic and broccoli florets 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Assemble bowls: rice, broccoli, sliced chicken.
Squeeze lemon over everything and serve.

name: Buffalo Chicken Wrap
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper; cook in olive oil over medium-high heat 6 minutes per side; slice thin.
Toss sliced chicken with hot sauce to coat.
Warm tortilla in a dry skillet for 30 seconds.
Layer romaine, halved cherry tomatoes, cheddar, and buffalo chicken on the tortilla.
Drizzle with ranch dressing, roll tightly, and cut in half.

name: Tuna Avocado Wrap
instructions: Drain tuna and mix with mayonnaise, salt, and pepper.
Mash avocado with lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm tortilla in a dry skillet for 30 seconds.
Spread avocado on the tortilla, then top with romaine, halved cherry tomatoes, and tuna mixture.
Roll tightly and cut in half to serve.

name: Penne Arrabbiata
instructions: Cook penne in salted boiling water per package directions; drain.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat; add sliced garlic and red pepper flakes and cook 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes, oregano, salt, and pepper; simmer 10 minutes.
Toss drained pasta into the sauce and cook 1 minute.
Serve immediately, adjusting red pepper to taste.

name: Sirloin Steak Salad
instructions: Season steak with salt and pepper; cook in a hot skillet over high heat 3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare; rest 5 minutes then slice thin.
Halve cherry tomatoes, dice cucumber, and thinly slice red onion.
Whisk olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper into a dressing.
Arrange romaine, tomatoes, cucumber, and onion in a bowl.
Top with sliced steak and drizzle with dressing.

name: Ground Turkey Lettuce Wraps
instructions: Finely dice the carrots; mince garlic and grate ginger.
Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat; cook ground turkey, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Add garlic, ginger, and carrots; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil; cook 1 minute.
Spoon turkey mixture into iceberg lettuce leaves.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve immediately.

name: Caprese Chicken Salad
instructions: Season chicken with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; cook in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat 6 minutes per side; slice.
Slice tomatoes.
Whisk remaining olive oil with balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Arrange baby spinach on a plate; top with sliced chicken, tomatoes, and mozzarella.
Drizzle dressing over the salad and serve.

name: Beef Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Cook jasmine rice per package directions.
Slice beef thinly; toss with cornstarch and 1 tsp soy sauce.
Whisk remaining soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil into a sauce.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat; sear beef 1–2 minutes per side; remove.
Add broccoli, bell pepper, and snap peas; stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger; stir-fry 30 seconds.
Return beef, pour in sauce, and toss 1 minute. Serve over rice with green onions.

name: Creamy Garlic Chicken Pasta
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water; reserve 0.25 cup pasta water before draining.
Season chicken with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; cook in olive oil over medium-high heat 6 minutes per side; slice.
In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat; add minced garlic and cook 1 minute.
Pour in heavy cream; simmer 2 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add Parmesan and stir until melted; add spinach and cook until wilted.
Toss in pasta with a splash of pasta water; add chicken on top and serve.

name: Pork Fried Rice
instructions: Cook jasmine rice and let cool.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat; cook pork, breaking it up, until browned; push to one side.
Add diced carrots; stir-fry 2 minutes, then add minced garlic and grated ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Scramble eggs in the center until just set, then mix everything together.
Add cooled rice and toss 2 minutes over high heat.
Drizzle soy sauce and sesame oil over rice; toss and garnish with green onions.

name: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Cook rice per package directions.
Season chicken with salt and pepper; brown in olive oil over medium-high heat 3 minutes per side; remove.
In the same skillet, sauté diced onion 3 minutes, add sliced mushrooms and bell pepper and cook 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute; stir in crushed tomatoes, Italian seasoning, and bay leaf.
Return chicken to the skillet; bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 25 minutes. Remove bay leaf.
Serve over rice.

name: Pork Carnitas Tacos
instructions: Rub pork with cumin, chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and salt.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat; sear pork 4 minutes per side until well browned.
Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook 20 more minutes until cooked through; shred with two forks.
Crisp shredded pork in the pan drippings 2–3 minutes on high heat.
Warm tortillas; fill with pork, shredded cabbage, sliced avocado, sour cream, and salsa.
Squeeze lime over each taco.

name: Classic Beef Chili
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot; sauté diced onion and bell pepper 4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute; add ground beef and cook until browned.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, and cayenne; cook 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes, both beans, and broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Season with salt and serve.

name: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water; reserve 0.25 cup pasta water before draining.
Thaw and pat shrimp dry; season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high heat; cook shrimp 1–2 minutes per side until pink; remove.
Add remaining butter and minced garlic to the pan; cook 1 minute. Add red pepper flakes.
Add pasta, a splash of pasta water, and spinach; toss until spinach wilts.
Return shrimp; squeeze lemon over everything. Finish with Parmesan.

name: Mushroom and Spinach Pasta
instructions: Cook penne in salted boiling water; reserve 0.25 cup pasta water before draining.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat; sauté sliced mushrooms 5 minutes until golden.
Add minced garlic, Italian seasoning, and red pepper flakes; cook 1 minute.
Pour in heavy cream; simmer 2 minutes. Add spinach and toss until wilted.
Add drained pasta and a splash of pasta water; toss to coat.
Remove from heat; stir in Parmesan and serve immediately.

name: Turkey Meatballs in Marinara
instructions: Mix ground turkey, bread crumbs, egg, minced garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; form into walnut-sized balls.
Brown meatballs in olive oil over medium heat 3 minutes per side.
Add marinara sauce; bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 15 minutes until cooked through.
Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water; drain.
Serve meatballs and sauce over spaghetti; finish with Parmesan.

name: Cauliflower Fried Rice
instructions: Pulse cauliflower florets in a food processor until they resemble rice grains.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat; stir-fry diced carrots and snap peas 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger; stir-fry 30 seconds.
Add cauliflower rice and stir-fry 4–5 minutes until tender.
Drizzle soy sauce and sesame oil; toss to combine.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken
instructions: Cook brown rice per package directions.
Whisk honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, lemon juice, and cornstarch into a sauce.
Season chicken with salt and pepper; cook in olive oil over medium-high heat 5–6 minutes per side.
Pour sauce over chicken; cook 2 minutes per side, basting until caramelized.
Steam or sauté green beans until tender-crisp.
Serve chicken over rice with green beans, drizzling pan sauce on top.

name: Black Bean Enchiladas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Sauté diced onion in olive oil 3 minutes; add minced garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in drained beans, half the chili powder, and cumin; mash slightly and season with salt.
Simmer crushed tomatoes with remaining chili powder for the sauce.
Warm tortillas; fill each with bean mixture; roll and place seam-side down in a baking dish.
Pour tomato sauce over the top; scatter cheddar and Monterey jack.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbly; serve with sour cream.

name: Beef Taco Bowl
instructions: Cook rice per package directions.
Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat; drain excess fat.
Stir in taco seasoning and 2 tbsp water; cook 2 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans and corn; warm in a small saucepan.
Assemble bowls: rice, shredded romaine, seasoned beef, beans, corn, sliced avocado, cheddar, sour cream, and salsa.
Squeeze lime over the bowl before serving.

name: Creamy Butternut Squash Soup
instructions: Peel and cube butternut squash; dice onion; mince garlic; grate ginger.
Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat; sauté onion 4 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute.
Add squash, cumin, cinnamon, cayenne, salt, and pepper; stir and cook 2 minutes.
Add enough water to cover (about 2 cups); bring to a boil, then simmer 20 minutes until squash is tender.
Blend with an immersion blender until smooth; stir in coconut milk and heat gently before serving.

name: Sun Dried Tomato Pasta
instructions: Cook penne in salted boiling water; reserve 0.25 cup pasta water before draining.
Chop sun-dried tomatoes.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat; add minced garlic and red pepper flakes; cook 1 minute.
Add sun-dried tomatoes and Italian seasoning; cook 1 minute.
Pour in heavy cream; simmer 2 minutes. Add spinach and wilt.
Toss in pasta with a splash of pasta water and Parmesan; serve immediately.

name: Spicy Shrimp Pasta
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water; reserve 0.25 cup pasta water before draining.
Pat shrimp dry; season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil over high heat; sear shrimp 1 minute per side until pink; remove.
Reduce to medium; add minced garlic and red pepper flakes; cook 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes; simmer 5 minutes. Add spinach and wilt.
Toss in pasta and shrimp with a splash of pasta water. Squeeze lemon over and finish with Parmesan.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Cook jasmine rice per package directions.
Cut chicken into cubes; season with half the garam masala, salt, and cayenne.
Cook chicken in olive oil over medium-high heat 4 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté diced onion 4 minutes in the same pan; add minced garlic and grated ginger; cook 1 minute.
Stir in remaining garam masala, curry powder, cumin, and turmeric; cook 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in cream; return chicken; simmer 5 more minutes.
Serve over jasmine rice.

name: Salmon Tacos
instructions: Season salmon with cumin, smoked paprika, chili powder, and salt.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat; cook salmon 4 minutes per side; flake into chunks.
Shred red cabbage; slice avocado; toss both with lime juice.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill each tortilla with salmon, cabbage, and avocado; top with sour cream and salsa.
Serve with extra lime wedges.

name: Spaghetti Squash Marinara
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Halve and seed the squash; brush with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roast cut-side down 35 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat; sauté minced garlic and red pepper flakes 1 minute.
Add marinara and Italian seasoning; simmer 5 minutes. Stir in spinach until wilted.
Rake squash flesh into strands with a fork.
Top with marinara sauce and finish with Parmesan.

name: Crispy Tilapia Tacos
instructions: Season tilapia with cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Cook in olive oil over medium-high heat 3–4 minutes per side until cooked through; break into pieces.
Shred cabbage; slice avocado; toss both with lime juice.
Mix sour cream with hot sauce for the crema.
Warm tortillas; fill with fish, cabbage slaw, and avocado.
Drizzle with crema and serve with extra lime wedges.

name: Sheet Pan Chicken and Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Quarter the potatoes; cut bell pepper and zucchini into chunks; cut broccoli into florets.
Toss chicken and all vegetables with olive oil, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Spread in a single layer on a large sheet pan, keeping chicken in the center.
Roast 25 minutes until chicken registers 165°F and vegetables are caramelized.
Serve directly from the pan.

name: Turkey Vegetable Soup
instructions: Dice onion, carrot, celery, and zucchini; mince garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat; cook turkey, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Add onion, carrot, and celery; cook 4 minutes.
Add garlic and Italian seasoning; cook 1 minute.
Pour in broth and diced tomatoes; bring to a boil.
Add zucchini; simmer 15 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and serve.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Peel and dice sweet potato; toss with olive oil, cumin, chili powder, smoked paprika, and salt.
Roast 20 minutes until caramelized and tender.
Drain and rinse black beans; warm in a saucepan with a pinch of cumin.
Warm tortillas; assemble with sweet potato, beans, shredded red cabbage, and sliced avocado.
Top with salsa and a squeeze of lime.

name: Baked Lemon Herb Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Cook brown rice per package directions.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, rosemary, thyme, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Coat chicken in the mixture; place in a baking dish. Toss asparagus in remaining marinade and arrange alongside.
Bake 22–25 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F.
Slice chicken and serve over brown rice with asparagus.

name: Ground Lamb Tacos
instructions: Cook diced onion and minced garlic in a dry skillet over medium heat 2 minutes.
Add ground lamb; cook, breaking it up, until browned.
Season with cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, cayenne, and salt; cook 2 minutes.
Dice tomatoes; shred romaine.
Warm tortillas; fill with spiced lamb, romaine, and tomato.
Top with sour cream and a squeeze of lime.

name: Pinto Bean Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat; sauté diced onion 4 minutes.
Add minced garlic, cumin, chili powder, and smoked paprika; cook 1 minute.
Add drained pinto beans, diced tomatoes, green chiles, and 1 cup water; stir to combine.
Bring to a boil; simmer uncovered 15 minutes.
Mash some beans against the pot to thicken; season with salt, pepper, and lime juice.
Serve as is or with warm corn tortillas.

name: Shrimp Coconut Curry
instructions: Cook jasmine rice per package directions.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat; sauté diced onion 4 minutes.
Add minced garlic, grated ginger, curry powder, turmeric, and cayenne; cook 1 minute.
Pour in coconut milk; bring to a simmer and cook 5 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes until pink. Stir in spinach until wilted.
Season with salt and lime juice; serve over jasmine rice.

name: Pasta e Fagioli
instructions: Dice onion, celery, and carrot; mince garlic.
Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat; sauté the vegetable trio 5 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, Italian seasoning, and rosemary; cook 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes and drained beans with 2 cups water; bring to a boil.
Add macaroni; cook 8–10 minutes until pasta is tender.
Mash some beans to thicken; season with salt and pepper. Serve with Parmesan.

name: Kale and Lentil Soup
instructions: Rinse lentils; dice onion, carrot, and celery; mince garlic.
Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat; sauté vegetables 5 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, turmeric, and smoked paprika; cook 1 minute.
Add lentils, diced tomatoes, and 3 cups water; bring to a boil.
Simmer 15 minutes until lentils are soft. Remove tough kale stems; chop and add; cook 5 more minutes.
Stir in lemon juice and salt; serve hot.

name: Chicken in Mushroom Cream Sauce
instructions: Cook white rice per package directions.
Season chicken with salt and pepper; cook in olive oil over medium-high heat 6 minutes per side; set aside.
Melt butter in the same skillet; sauté sliced mushrooms 5 minutes until golden.
Add minced garlic and thyme; cook 1 minute.
Pour in heavy cream; simmer 2 minutes. Stir in Parmesan until melted.
Slice chicken; return to the skillet and coat with sauce. Serve over rice.

name: Mango Chicken Bowl
instructions: Cook jasmine rice per package directions.
Whisk honey, sriracha, soy sauce, and lime juice into a sauce.
Season chicken with cumin and salt; cook in olive oil over medium-high heat 5–6 minutes per side; slice.
Dice mango; slice bell pepper and shred red cabbage.
Assemble bowls: rice, sliced chicken, mango, bell pepper, and cabbage.
Drizzle sauce over everything and serve.

name: Vegetarian Three Bean Chili
instructions: Dice onion and both bell peppers; mince garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot; sauté onion and peppers 5 minutes.
Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, and cayenne; cook 1 minute.
Add all three drained beans, diced tomatoes, and 0.5 cup water; stir well.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer uncovered 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and serve.

name: Fresh Fruit Salad
instructions: Hull and halve the strawberries; dice the mango; slice the banana.
Peel and segment the orange.
Combine all fruit in a bowl.
Drizzle with honey and a squeeze of lime; toss gently and serve.

name: Celery with Peanut Butter
instructions: Wash and trim celery stalks; cut into 3-inch pieces.
Spread peanut butter into each celery piece and serve.

name: Crispy Spiced Chickpeas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; pat very dry with paper towels.
Toss with olive oil, smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt.
Spread in a single layer on a sheet pan.
Roast 25–30 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crispy.
Let cool 5 minutes; they will crisp further as they cool.

name: Mango Yogurt Dip with Fruit
instructions: Peel and finely dice the mango.
Mix Greek yogurt with diced mango and honey until combined.
Hull and halve the strawberries.
Serve the yogurt dip alongside fresh strawberries and blueberries for dipping.
